title: Familiarity Evidence Dashboard y cierre de nivel
review_contracts: PYARCANA — MODO REVISOR ESCÉPTICO Y ANTI-COMPLACENCIA
Solarized Website Content Comprehension Auditor & Rewriter

learner_entry_state.credit_rule: Only concepts marked USABLE in the effective prior ledger count as learned.
not_creditable: referential integrity merely from SQL naming
Level-1 closure merely because S13 says it closes the level

roadmap_expectation.T1: normalization, blocking and entity resolution; labeled truth, precision/recall and clerical review
roadmap_expectation.T2: shared email/phone/address, distance and surnames; direct transactions and common counterparties
roadmap_expectation.T3: evidence score, uncertainty and explanation; review threshold, abstention and no automatic inference
roadmap_expectation.T4: pseudonymized dashboard/map and case sheet; privacy, access, tests, demo and runbook
roadmap_expectation.gate: deterministic ER with entity_resolution_score separate from relationship_signal_score, traceable geoevidence, human review and explicit limits
roadmap_expectation.promotion: three N1 capstones, S1-S13 level regression and CF-1 approved
roadmap_expectation.CF1_authoritative: stakeholders, jobs-to-be-done, success metrics, constraints/no-go, contracts and base demo; owner/reviewer, complete traceability, synthetic demo and green N1 tests; checkpoint records version/revision, date, owner, reviewer, paths/hashes, commands, results and issues
roadmap_expectation.level_regression_authoritative: critical tests of all three N1 capstones, E2E integration, one recovery item per prior topic, privacy/security controls; zero critical failures and at least 80% of noncritical evidence

live_site.note: Public rendered page remained unavailable through the supported page fetch. Source-level renderer inspection was used only where behavior is provable from SectionView/RichText; no screenshot or hydrated-layout parity claim is made.

confirmed_findings.evidence: ER, CP-N1-C, CF-1, gate, scaffold, runbook, egress and cola clerical recur as compact labels; several are expanded only after they already carry instructional weight.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can follow the local sentence yet not know whether a label names a metric, project checkpoint, course-internal gate, interface artifact or operational procedure.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Use Spanish head terms first and expand each internal acronym/ID once at first use; keep the short label only afterward.

confirmed_findings.evidence: S13 says the S12 HTTP client with timeout/retries and geographic egress policy are inherited and will not be rebuilt. The effective S12 ledger leaves real HTTP request construction MENTION_ONLY, retry/backoff MISCONCEPTION_RISK and egress enforcement PARTIAL/prose-only.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The capstone can treat missing or unsafe infrastructure as a solved prerequisite and wire it into the final product without ever seeing a correct implementation.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Revalidate only the unsafe S12 edges at S13 entry: one real/faked synchronous GET adapter, bounded idempotent retry, and executable egress guard before integration.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Prose says blocking uses several keys and a document key rescues pairs split by the surname/region key. The code has one block_key and scores an already-selected pair; it never generates candidate pairs or unions multiple blocking passes.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner can implement a key formatter but cannot implement blocking as a candidate-generation algorithm; true pairs separated by the only key are never compared.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Show a tiny candidate generator that produces pairs from at least two blocking keys and unions/deduplicates the candidate pairs before fine comparison.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The paragraph defines 1.0 for same document+block, 0.5 for same document only, and 0.0 otherwise. Canonical theory code implements only 1.0 when both match, else 0.0. Spot-check same document/different region returned 0.0.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner cannot know which contract is canonical and will produce different scores depending on whether they copied prose or code.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Make the theory code implement exactly the documented 1.0/0.5/0.0 cascade and test all three branches.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Prose says missing document, empty name or unusable block fails closed. block_key indexes parts[0] on an empty name and calls casefold on region without validation. Spot-checks raised IndexError for empty name and AttributeError for region=None.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: Bad input crashes the capstone instead of producing a reviewable invalid-data state, contradicting the safety model being taught.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Validate required strings before normalization/blocking and return an explicit invalid_candidate/error result rather than indexing/casefolding unchecked values.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The lesson explicitly demonstrates that parts[1] misclassifies its own opening example 'Ana María Quispe Rojas' as surname 'maría', yet makes parts[1] the canonical paternal-surname rule. Prior S07 name parsing remains MISCONCEPTION_RISK.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner is taught to knowingly encode a parsing rule that breaks common multi-token given names, causing systematic missed candidates when document evidence is absent or dirty.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Use the already-structured apellido_paterno field in the synthetic schema; if only a full name is available, label token parsing as a lossy fallback and route ambiguity to review instead of making it canonical.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The text says imperfect recall is compensated by the clerical queue. A queue only reviews candidates routed to it; false negatives rejected below the queue or eliminated during blocking are never recovered by that queue.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner can accept poor candidate recall believing human review repairs missed pairs that humans never see.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: State that clerical review reduces risk only for surfaced uncertain candidates; blocking/candidate recall must be measured separately because missed candidates are unrecoverable downstream.

confirmed_findings.evidence: T1-B defines the clerical band as [0.4, 0.7], while T3-B routes every score from 0.4 up to but not including 0.8 to needs_review.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: Scores in [0.7,0.8) have two incompatible operational policies depending on which subsection the learner follows.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Choose one review band and reuse the same named thresholds everywhere.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Prose says non-finite label/score input fails closed. pr_metrics accepts arbitrary tuple values and silently ignores malformed labels/predictions. Spot-check malformed values produced tp=fp=fn=0 rather than an error.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: Corrupt evaluation data can silently look like zero errors instead of invalid evaluation evidence.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Validate truth/prediction values against an explicit binary schema before counting; reject malformed/nonfinite inputs with a clear error.

confirmed_findings.evidence: When TP+FP or TP+FN is zero, the helper returns 0.0 without distinguishing 'metric is undefined because denominator is zero' from a measured precision/recall of zero.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A reviewer can interpret lack of evaluable positives as genuine model performance of 0.0 and miss that the evaluation set/prediction policy is degenerate.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Return/print an explicit undefined marker or status alongside the metric when the denominator is zero.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The signal is named surname_jaccard, but surname_overlap tokenizes each full name. For 'Ana Quispe Rojas' vs 'Luis Quispe Díaz' the code reports 0.2 because given names are in the union; the surnames alone have Jaccard 1/3 ≈ 0.333.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner believes a surname-similarity feature is being computed while the implementation also penalizes unrelated given-name tokens, corrupting the meaning of the feature and its weight.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Compute Jaccard from explicit surname fields/tokens only, or rename the feature to full_name_token_jaccard and change the prose/weights accordingly.

confirmed_findings.evidence: shared_contact returns None when a field is missing and '' when empty because it uses 'a.get(field) and ...'. The weighted formula expects a numeric/boolean; 0.5 * None raises TypeError.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: Exactly the missing-field case that prose says should fail closed can crash score calculation instead of producing an explicit unavailable signal.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Return an explicit signal state/value such as False plus available=False, and make scoring policy handle unavailable evidence deliberately.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Each entity dict carries a single km field and geo_close_pair requires both entities to report the same km. Distance is a property of a pair of coordinates/entities, not an intrinsic per-entity attribute; one entity has different distances to different peers.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner can persist/reuse one 'km' on an entity as if it were universally meaningful, producing impossible relationship evidence when the entity is compared with multiple peers.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Compute or store distance on the pair/evidence object from two coordinates, with source/provenance, never as a scalar property of each entity.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Roadmap T2 calls for shared email/phone/address plus distance/surnames. Theory's canonical relationship implementation demonstrates phone, geo and name-token overlap only; email/address are not integrated into the taught score/evidence model.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner reaches the capstone without a canonical treatment of two roadmap-required relationship signals or their missing/normalization semantics.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Add one compact signal registry/example that includes email and address availability/normalization, even if their N1 weight is zero or they remain explanatory evidence.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Prose defines common counterparties as 'A and C pay D'. counterparties treats edges as undirected. Counterexample A->D and D->C still yields D as common even though C did not pay D.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: Direction-sensitive transaction evidence is silently converted into undirected adjacency, so the dashboard can describe a common payee pattern that did not occur.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Define the intended relation (e.g. outgoing payees) and intersect outgoing_counterparties(A) with outgoing_counterparties(C); teach a separate undirected relation only if desired and name it differently.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The lesson insists ER and relationship are different constructs, then sets uncertainty=high whenever |ER-REL|>0.5. High ER and low REL can be completely coherent: the same person/identity can have little relationship evidence to another entity.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner is taught that disagreement between deliberately independent scores is evidence of uncertainty, reintroducing the conceptual fusion the lesson repeatedly warns against.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Compute uncertainty from evidence quality within each construct (missing fields, contradictory identity rules, provenance/quality) rather than from numerical distance between ER and REL.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The lesson requires a reviewer to reconstruct the decision in five minutes and says each score must show the signals that produced it. explain() exposes only aggregate ER, aggregate REL, missing fields and rules_version; it omits component rules/signals, weights, pair/case identity, source/provenance and calculation inputs.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A reviewer can recompute the 0.6/0.4 blend but cannot reconstruct why ER or REL had their values, so the underlying decision remains unauditable.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Include component evidence with raw/normalized synthetic inputs or stable references, weights/rules fired, pair/case id, source/provenance and rules version.

confirmed_findings.evidence: T3-A correctly warns that evidence_score must never drive identity acceptance, but the immediately following function is decide_ops_status(score, uncertainty) and its prose/table use the generic term score rather than entity_resolution_score.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner can naturally pass the just-created evidence_score into the next subsection and accept an identity pair because relationship evidence pushed the blended score over 0.8.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Rename the parameter/table column to entity_resolution_score and show the exact call site from a case card, keeping evidence_score only for queue ordering.

confirmed_findings.evidence: A gate-level portfolio audit instructs the learner to use grep. S01 did not leave shell portability safe to inherit; grep is not a guaranteed default command on Windows.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A Windows learner can be blocked from performing a mandatory safety audit by tooling the course never established portably.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Provide a Python stdlib repository scan as the canonical cross-platform mechanism; optionally mention grep as a Unix convenience.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The decision table is authored as twelve separate paragraph strings containing Markdown table rows. SectionView joins theory paragraphs with blank lines. RichText.parseBlocks supports paragraphs/lists/code/callouts but no table parsing; therefore the central matrix is parsed as literal pipe-delimited paragraphs, not a table.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The most important decision policy loses row/column structure in the rendered lesson, raising comparison load and making exact boundary rules harder to scan or access semantically.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Represent the matrix with a renderer-supported structure (ordered list or dedicated table component) or add tested Markdown-table support to RichText.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The theory promises an auditable dashboard/map scaffold but dashboard_scaffold.py only builds three dictionaries and prints rows; it creates no HTML/UI/map. A standalone FamiliarityDashboard component exists in the app, but the S13 lesson neither embeds nor links to that #familiarity view, and the normal SectionView does not mount it.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can finish all S13 theory code yet still have no learner-visible path from those dictionaries to the dashboard/map artifact that the outcome and gate require.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Provide/teach a minimal static scaffold artifact in the lesson or explicitly link/embed the supplied dashboard template and show how the S13 case schema feeds it.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The synthetic demo replaces every name token with first initial + *** and calls this pseudonymization, but it does not state that initials combined with city/map/other quasi-identifiers may remain linkable in real data.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner can transfer the synthetic-display technique to real cases and interpret masked names as anonymized/safe-to-share data.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Add one sentence: display masking/pseudonymization reduces direct exposure but does not anonymize real records; real-data release requires separate privacy assessment/minimization.

confirmed_findings.evidence: S13 repeatedly defines CF-1 as privacy sheet + demo + runbook/access. The authoritative roadmap defines CF-1 as stakeholders, jobs-to-be-done, success metrics, constraints/no-go, contracts and base demo, with owner/reviewer and complete traceability; checkpoint records version/revision, date, paths/hashes, commands, results and issues.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can satisfy S13's stated CF-1 and be told the level closes while missing mandatory artifacts required by the curriculum authority.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Replace S13's local CF-1 checklist with the authoritative CF-1 schema and show one complete synthetic manifest row.

confirmed_findings.evidence: S13 reduces level regression to re-running 'critical checks' from LEVEL1_REGRESSION_MATRIX and noting pass/fail; ops_cf1.py only prints 'S01-S13 checklist required'. Roadmap requires critical tests of all three capstones, E2E integration, a recovery item per previous topic and privacy/security controls with explicit gate evidence.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner can self-attest thirteen text lines instead of executing the regression evidence required for promotion.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Teach an executable regression manifest/harness that records command, exit/result, evidence path/hash and criticality for each required capstone/E2E/privacy/security check.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The lesson requires one-command clean-machine reproduction with 'python -m demo_n1_dashboard --synthetic', but theory only prints that string and repository code search did not find a demo_n1_dashboard module on main.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner is instructed to demonstrate a command whose module is neither built nor supplied by the theory, so the promised reproducible gate can fail immediately with module-not-found.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Provide the module/template as an explicit learner artifact or teach how to create it from the completed pipeline, then run the exact command as verification instead of printing it.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Prose says the sheet fixes local retention, viewer/reviewer access and what leaves the environment. Code records data_class, pii_real, egress label and role names, but no retention period/rule, no permission matrix and no evidence behind the self-assertion pii_real=False.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: A learner can present a few labels as a privacy control without specifying retention or what each role may actually see/do.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Add retention, field-level/operation-level access notes, egress fields and evidence/source showing the fixture is synthetic.

confirmed_findings.evidence: The same trigger 'token_or_name_in_log' always produces rotate_secret, redact_logs, postmortem. Secret exposure and personal-data exposure have different first containment/evidence/notification questions; rotating a secret does not remediate a leaked name.
confirmed_findings.learner_failure_mode: The learner can apply a rote three-word response without identifying what leaked, where it propagated, whether credentials remain active, or what privacy containment is needed.
confirmed_findings.minimal_fix: Split secret_leak and pii_log_leak branches with causal actions; define postmortem in plain language and record affected logs/scope before claiming closure.

rejected_findings.reason: It is the correct count of unordered distinct record pairs.
The canonical formulas and 2TP/1FP/1FN example are correct.

rejected_findings.candidate: T3-B decision matrix has numeric holes or mishandles bool/NaN
rejected_findings.reason: The canonical function validates bool/type/isfinite/range/uncertainty and covers the stated boundaries correctly.

rejected_findings.candidate: Any ER+REL evidence score is inherently invalid
rejected_findings.reason: The lesson explicitly scopes evidence_score to human queue prioritization and warns against using it for identity acceptance; the confirmed defects are the cross-construct uncertainty rule and ambiguous next-step parameter.
The lesson repeatedly defines it as an operational identity-pair action and forbids legal/fraud/kinship inference.

rejected_findings.candidate: Pseudonymized synthetic fixtures constitute a current PII leak
rejected_findings.reason: The examples are synthetic; the confirmed issue is the missing transfer caveat for real data.

rejected_findings.candidate: Blocking is defective merely because it can miss matches
rejected_findings.reason: Blocking is inherently recall-sensitive candidate reduction; the material defects are unimplemented multi-key rescue and the known-broken canonical surname heuristic.

rejected_findings.candidate: collusion_claim=False itself declares no collusion as a factual verdict
rejected_findings.reason: In context it records that the system is not making a collusion claim; the lesson consistently forbids such inference.

rejected_findings.candidate: Fixed relationship weights are invalid because they are not statistically calibrated
rejected_findings.reason: They are explicitly framed as a deterministic N1 course policy, not a calibrated probability.

rejected_findings.candidate: Audit the standalone FamiliarityDashboard component's algorithms/UI as part of S13 lesson
rejected_findings.reason: The campaign audits lesson theory only; component existence is used solely to establish an unbridged external dependency.

adversarial_questions.question: Can a learner implement the claimed multi-key blocking candidate pipeline from S13 theory alone?
adversarial_questions.answer: No. The theory code formats one key and scores a supplied pair; it never builds or unions candidate sets from multiple blocking passes.

adversarial_questions.question: Can a reviewer reconstruct a case decision in five minutes from the canonical case card?
adversarial_questions.answer: No. The card exposes aggregate ER/REL/missing/rules_version but not the component rules, input/provenance and weights that created ER/REL.

adversarial_questions.question: Can a learner satisfy the authoritative N1/CF-1 promotion gate by following S13 theory exactly?
adversarial_questions.answer: No. The local CF-1 definition and level-regression evidence are materially incomplete, and the one-command demo target is not realized in the lesson/repository evidence inspected.

technical_spot_checks.observed: same normalized doc + same block -> 1.0; same doc + different region -> 0.0 although prose promises 0.5
empty name raises IndexError; region=None raises AttributeError, contradicting fail-closed prose
malformed labels/predictions are silently ignored; zero denominator becomes 0.0
missing field returns None and empty field returns empty string; multiplying None by a weight raises TypeError
full-name token Jaccard for Ana Quispe Rojas vs Luis Quispe Díaz = 0.2; surname-only Jaccard = 1/3
A->D plus D->C is still reported as common D because adjacency is treated as undirected, contradicting 'A and C pay D'
ER=.95, REL=.10, no missing -> evidence_score=.61 and uncertainty=high solely due cross-construct gap
-.1 invalid; .399 abstain; .4/.799 review; .8 accept; .9/high review; NaN invalid — canonical boundary code is correct
SectionView joins each paragraph with a blank line; RichText has no table block/parser, so the individually stored Markdown table rows are parsed as ordinary paragraphs with literal pipes

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: «Ana María Quispe Rojas...». «Ana M. Quispe R....». ¿Es la misma persona?... la duda es información.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar el párrafo actual.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Strong concrete problem framing; no unsupported mechanism is required yet.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Decidir si dos filas hablan de la misma entidad se llama resolución de identidad... ese recorte previo se llama bloqueo.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Resolver identidad significa decidir qué filas podrían referirse a la misma entidad. Antes de aplicar reglas detalladas, el sistema genera una lista reducida de pares candidatos mediante una o más claves baratas —por ejemplo, región+apellido estructurado y, en una pasada separada, documento normalizado— y une los pares encontrados. Ese paso es blocking: reduce comparaciones sin fingir que una sola clave puede encontrar todos los matches.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Adds the missing candidate-generation mechanism and avoids implying that merely having a block key is blocking.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: ...tres caminos: unir, rechazar, o mandar a la cola clerical... incertidumbre baja, media o alta.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Los pares candidatos terminan en tres rutas operativas: aceptar el par de identidad, rechazarlo o enviarlo a una cola de revisión humana (cola clerical). La cola contiene solo los casos que el sistema sí llegó a comparar y cuya evidencia no basta para decidir automáticamente; no recupera pares que el blocking nunca generó.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Spanish-first terminology and explicit scope of human review.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: El puntaje que dice ‘estas dos filas son la misma persona’ y el puntaje que dice ‘estas dos personas están relacionadas’ son cosas distintas...
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar el párrafo actual.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: This is the correct core separation and is later used as an audit invariant.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: ¿podría alguien que no escribió este código reconstruir la decisión en cinco minutos?... cada puntaje muestre de qué señales salió y qué le faltó.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La prueba de auditabilidad es concreta: otra persona debe poder reconstruir cada puntaje a partir de la ficha. Para eso la ficha debe nombrar el par/caso, las señales y reglas que se activaron, los valores o referencias de entrada, los pesos, lo que faltó, la procedencia y la versión de reglas. Mostrar solo el número final no permite reconstruirlo.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Makes the five-minute claim operational rather than rhetorical.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Bloque de referencia. Orden de los subtemas, ritmo, criterio de cierre y promoción de nivel.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Orientation only.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: T1 trata la identidad... T4 cierra con el producto y la operación, más el paquete CF-1.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: T1 trata identidad; T2 señales de relación; T3 decisión operativa y explicación; T4 producto y operación. El cierre incluye CF-1, el primer checkpoint transversal del curso, cuyo contenido completo se enumera en T4-B.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Expands CF-1 before relying on it.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Ritmo orientativo (unas 9 horas)...
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: No material technical/pedagogical defect.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Criterio de cierre (CP-N1-C): dos puntajes... cola clerical... privacy sheet... demo en un comando.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: CP-N1-C cierra cuando el dashboard muestra ER y relación por separado, la revisión humana funciona, la geoevidencia conserva procedencia, la ficha de privacidad está completa y el comando de demo existe y se ejecuta desde una instalación limpia; imprimir el comando no cuenta como evidencia de que funcione.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Separates capstone evidence from a printed string and avoids incomplete closure.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Promoción de nivel: tres capstones... regresión S01-S13... paquete CF-1 —privacidad, demostración y runbook—.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La promoción exige los tres capstones N1, la regresión ejecutable del nivel y CF-1 completo. CF-1 registra stakeholders, jobs-to-be-done, métricas de éxito, restricciones/no-go, contratos, demo base, owner y revisor, además de versión/fecha, paths o hashes, comandos, resultados e issues. La regresión ejecuta pruebas críticas de los tres capstones, integración E2E, recuperación de temas previos y controles de privacidad/seguridad.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Aligns lesson with authoritative roadmap rather than redefining the gate locally.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Qué se hereda de S12: cliente HTTP con timeout y reintentos, SQL parametrizado y señal geográfica con política de salida; aquí no se vuelven a construir.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: S12 introdujo HTTP/timeout/retry, SQL parametrizado y geodatos, pero S13 no puede asumir como seguros los bordes que todavía son frágiles. Antes de integrarlos, revalida un GET síncrono con timeout y retry solo cuando repetir sea seguro, y ejecuta una allowlist de salida que bloquee PII antes de cualquier geocoder externo. Después conecta esas salidas validadas a la ficha.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Repairs a broken prerequisite edge at the capstone boundary.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Solo datos sintéticos pseudonimizados... si falta evidencia o schema no cuadra, falla cerrado.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: En S13 solo se usan datos sintéticos. La vista puede enmascarar nombres para practicar minimización, pero ese enmascarado no convierte datos reales en anónimos. Si falta evidencia o el schema no cumple el contrato, el caso queda inválido o en revisión; no se inventan joins, coordenadas ni veredictos.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Preserves synthetic-data safety and adds the missing transfer boundary.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: ER responde ¿es la misma entidad?... casefold y limpieza antes de comparar.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Correct mental model and sequencing.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Blocking apellido paterno+región... usa varias claves... parts[1]... Ana María rompe la regla... documento como segunda clave rescata.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Blocking reduce pares candidatos, pero debe preservar recall suficiente. En el dataset sintético usa el campo estructurado apellido_paterno junto con región para una pasada y documento normalizado para otra; luego une y deduplica los pares candidatos de ambas pasadas. No derives el apellido canónico con parts[1]: ‘Ana María Quispe Rojas’ demuestra por qué un nombre de pila de varios tokens vuelve ambigua esa heurística. Si solo existe nombre completo, trátalo como fallback lossy y envía la ambigüedad a revisión.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Removes a knowingly broken canonical parser and actually teaches multi-key blocking.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Contrato N1: 1.0 doc+block; 0.5 solo doc; 0.0 otro caso.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Después de generar candidatos, el score ER de esta regla didáctica es 1.0 si coinciden documento normalizado y bloque estructurado, 0.5 si coincide solo el documento y 0.0 en otro caso. El bloque de código debe ejecutar y probar las tres ramas con los mismos fixtures que describe este párrafo.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Forces prose/code contract alignment.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Si falta document_id, nombre vacío o bloque sin tokens, no inventes 1.0... fail-closed.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Valida antes de bloquear: document_id, apellido_paterno/región y demás campos requeridos deben ser strings utilizables. Si falta un requerido, devuelve un estado explícito invalid_input o necesita revisión; no indexes una lista vacía ni llames métodos sobre None. Fallar cerrado significa controlar el caso, no dejar que Python explote incidentalmente.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Makes fail-closed observable and implementable.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Con pares sintéticos etiquetados calculas TP/FP/FN... precision/recall... ground truth del fixture.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Definitions/formulas are correct and scoped to synthetic ground truth.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: En ER alto riesgo priorizas precision... recall imperfecto se compensa con cola clerical... [0.4,0.7]... fail closed.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: En este ejercicio de alto costo por merge falso priorizas precision y envías a revisión humana los candidatos en la banda review_low=0.40 hasta accept_min=0.80. Esa cola reduce riesgo solo para pares que el blocking sí produjo; no recupera falsos negativos descartados antes. Antes de calcular métricas valida que truth/pred sean etiquetas binarias válidas y que los scores usados por la política sean numéricos finitos.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Corrects recall misconception, unifies thresholds and makes validation causal.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: 6 pares, 2 TP, 1 FP, 1 FN -> precision .667 recall .667; no publicar accuracy solo.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Con 2 TP, 1 FP y 1 FN, precision=2/3 y recall=2/3 ≈0.667. Publica ambos junto con TP/FP/FN. Si no hay predicciones positivas o no hay positivos reales, marca la métrica correspondiente como undefined/no evaluable en vez de confundir esa ausencia con un rendimiento medido de 0.0.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Adds correct zero-denominator semantics without changing the worked example.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Un FP no implica fraude... colisión de identidad estimada.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Important ethical boundary, technically sound.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: relationship score... shared_phone, geo_close, surname_jaccard.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: El score de relación reúne señales explícitas y separadas de identidad: teléfono/email/dirección compartidos cuando existen, cercanía geográfica del par y similitud de apellidos calculada sobre campos de apellido —no sobre todos los tokens del nombre completo. Cada señal conserva nombre, disponibilidad, valor y fuente para que el revisor sepa qué significa.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Corrects the false feature label and covers the roadmap signal family.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: rel=0.5 phone +0.3 geo +0.2 surname_jaccard; ambos registros reportan el mismo km.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La fórmula didáctica N1 puede conservar 0.5·shared_phone + 0.3·geo_close + 0.2·surname_jaccard, pero geo_close se calcula para el par: toma las coordenadas/procedencia de A y B, calcula o recupera la distancia del par y compara con el umbral. No guardes ‘km de la relación’ como una propiedad idéntica dentro de cada entidad.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Moves pair-relative evidence to the correct domain scope.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: phone compartido + km=1.2 en ambos + Jaccard de apellidos .2 -> rel .84.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Caso trabajado: phone compartido=1, distancia del par=1.2 km -> geo_close=1 y Jaccard de apellidos explícitos=1/3 para {Quispe,Rojas} vs {Quispe,Díaz}. Con los pesos N1, rel=0.5+0.3+0.2·(1/3)≈0.867. La ficha lista cada señal y su procedencia; kinship_verdict permanece ausente/None porque el score no prueba parentesco.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Uses the feature the prose names and a correctly scoped distance.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Si falta señal con peso no cero, no inventes True ni km promedio... señal != parentesco.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Si una señal está ausente, representa explícitamente available=False y aplica la política documentada para evidencia faltante; no uses None accidentalmente dentro de una suma ponderada. Ausencia no equivale a False observado. En ningún caso apellido/teléfono/distancia autorizan is_family=true.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Prevents missing data from crashing or masquerading as observed negative evidence.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: A↔B y contrapartes comunes (A y C pagan a D) son evidencia operativa, no colusión.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Define primero la dirección de la señal: una transacción directa puede resumirse como existencia del par A↔B, pero una contraparte común ‘A y C pagan a D’ exige comparar receptores salientes de A y C. No conviertas automáticamente todo el grafo dirigido en vecinos no dirigidos.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Prevents semantic drift between direct-pair and common-payee evidence.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: graphlet triples emisor-receptor-monto... direct_tx/common_counterparty... RelationshipEvidence.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Representa cada transacción como emisor→receptor+monto y cada evidencia como type, ids, direction_semantics, value/count, source y explanation. Para common_counterparty conserva via y especifica que via proviene de la intersección de receptores salientes. Así el objeto conserva suficiente traza para reconstruir la evidencia.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Aligns data structure with directional meaning and auditability.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: A↔B 2 tx y A,C→D -> direct_tx + common_counterparty via D; collusion_claim=False.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO en el escenario descrito; el código debe respetar exactamente su dirección.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: The scenario itself is valid; implementation is the problem.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: grafo vacío/no vecinos -> lista vacía; no inventar; no flag colusión.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: SIN_CAMBIO — conservar.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Correct fail-empty and inference boundary.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: case card: evidence_score + uncertainty + tres bullets; no publicar score sin bullets.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La ficha debe llevar evidence_score, una banda de calidad/incertidumbre y una explicación que permita reconstruirlo. Tres líneas genéricas no bastan por sí mismas: incluye al menos las reglas/señales componentes, sus valores o referencias, pesos, missing y versión de reglas.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Raises explanation from count-of-bullets to reproducible evidence.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: evidence_score=0.6 ER+0.4 REL para ordenar cola... uncertainty high si |ER-REL|>.5 o >=2 missing.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: evidence_score puede ordenar la cola humana, pero nunca decide identidad. Mantén entity_resolution_score como entrada exclusiva de la política de accept/review. La banda de incertidumbre se deriva de calidad dentro de cada constructo —campos faltantes, reglas de identidad contradictorias, evidencia sin procedencia—; no de |ER−REL|, porque identidad y relación están diseñadas para poder diferir sin conflicto.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Removes a contradiction in the lesson's central construct separation and clarifies the next-step handoff.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: explain(.9,.4,['phone']) -> .7, med... rules_version.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: En el ejemplo, muestra además pair_id/case_id, componentes que construyeron ER y REL, sus pesos, missing, source/provenance y rules_version. Entonces el revisor puede recalcular tanto los scores base como evidence_score, no solo la mezcla final.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Makes audit reconstruction possible.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: faltan campos -> uncertainty; señales conflictivas ER alto REL bajo se explican.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Campos obligatorios faltantes o evidencia interna contradictoria elevan la banda de calidad/revisión. ER alto y REL bajo, por sí solos, no son conflicto: pueden describir perfectamente una identidad fuerte con poca relación operativa. Explícalos por separado y conserva sus límites.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Stops treating independent constructs as mutually validating.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: decide qué hacer con un par: invalid_input/abstain/needs_review/accept_pair; nunca auto_fraud/is_family.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La política decide qué hacer con un par de identidad usando entity_resolution_score y la calidad/incertidumbre de identidad: invalid_input, abstain, needs_review o accept_pair. evidence_score solo ordena trabajo humano y no entra a esta función. Ningún estado equivale a fraude, parentesco o veredicto legal.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Names the actual input construct at the policy boundary.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: decide_ops_status(score, uncertainty) recorre cinco reglas.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La función decide_identity_status(entity_resolution_score, identity_uncertainty) evalúa cinco reglas en orden y devuelve el primer estado aplicable.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Eliminates generic score handoff hazard.

paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Exact boundary examples are correct.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Human-in-the-loop... acción de datos, no veredicto legal/KYC/lista negra.

paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Correct operational/legal boundary.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: busca con grep y elimina cualquier path is_family/auto_fraud... DECISION_MATRIX.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Audita el proyecto con un script Python portable que recorra archivos de texto y falle si encuentra asignaciones/salidas prohibidas como is_family o auto_fraud. En Unix puedes usar grep como atajo opcional, pero el gate no debe depender de una herramienta de shell que Windows no garantiza.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Makes the mandatory safety scan cross-platform.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: gate pide scaffold auditable: tres fichas + puntos de mapa... revisor en cinco minutos.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: El gate necesita un artefacto visible, no solo dicts impresos. Usa el scaffold estático proporcionado o una página HTML mínima que reciba la lista de tres casos y dibuje fichas + puntos sintéticos; enlaza explícitamente desde S13 a esa plantilla y muestra el mapeo de campos case_id/ER/REL/lat/lon/tooltip.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Bridges lesson code to the product outcome.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: pseudonimiza nombres A*** Q***; egress S12; ER y REL separados.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Para la demo sintética enmascara nombres en la vista y conserva ER/REL separados. Antes de cualquier proveedor externo ejecuta la allowlist de egress; no confíes solo en una regla escrita. En datos reales, iniciales + ciudad/mapa siguen pudiendo ser linkables: enmascarar no equivale a anonimizar.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Repairs inherited egress debt and privacy transfer risk.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: Los tres aparecen en el demo I Do y en el scaffold de teoría.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: si no coords/no puede pseudonimizarse, no inventes nombre/latlon; source tooltip explícito; portfolio screenshot.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: Si faltan coordenadas, omite el punto y muestra el motivo; no inventes un domicilio. El tooltip conserva source/provenance. En la demo sintética puedes capturar la vista; con datos reales una captura requiere revisar también quasi-identificadores, no solo enmascarar el nombre.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Keeps fail-closed map behavior and adds realistic privacy boundary.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: CF-1 privacy sheet fija synthetic_only, retención local, egress, viewer/reviewer...
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La privacy sheet es una parte de CF-1, no CF-1 completo. Registra clase/fuente sintética, campos guardados, retención, egress permitido/prohibido y permisos concretos de viewer/reviewer. CF-1 añade stakeholders/JTBD, métricas de éxito, no-go, contratos, owner/reviewer y trazabilidad versionada del checkpoint.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Aligns local privacy artifact with authoritative gate and fills missing retention/access semantics.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: tests green; demo one-command python -m demo_n1_dashboard --synthetic; runbook incident token or name -> rotate_secret/redact_logs/postmortem; clean machine.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La entrega ejecuta —no imprime— el comando de demo de un módulo que existe en el proyecto y comprueba su exit status/output en una instalación limpia. El runbook separa incidentes: secret_leak -> revocar/rotar credencial, localizar usos y sanear logs; pii_log_leak -> contener acceso/propagación, identificar datos/personas afectadas según política y sanear los registros. Después documenta causa, alcance y reparación en un postmortem breve.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Turns decorative command/playbook labels into executable and causal operations.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: artefactos CF-1 + checklist S01-S13 cierran nivel; ~30 min re-ejecuta checks críticos de LEVEL1_REGRESSION_MATRIX y anota pass/fail.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: La regresión de nivel no es un checklist autoafirmado: ejecuta pruebas críticas de CP-N1-A/B/C, una integración E2E, recuperación de temas anteriores y controles de privacidad/seguridad. Cada fila del manifest registra criticality, comando, resultado, evidence path/hash y issue si falla; el gate exige cero fallas críticas y el umbral de evidencia no crítica definido por el roadmap.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Restores evidence-based promotion contract.

paragraph_level_audit.current_excerpt: demo no escribe aprobado en ledger; gate formal es revisión humana.
paragraph_level_audit.improved_version: El script produce evidencia verificable; no se autoconcede la promoción. El gate formal revisa el manifest de CF-1 y la regresión contra sus criterios, con owner/reviewer y resultados trazables. Solo ese proceso puede marcar el checkpoint aprobado.
paragraph_level_audit.rationale: Preserves correct no-self-approval idea while connecting it to the actual gate artifacts.

concept_ledger_delta.reason: Construct separation is strong, but canonical candidate/blocking mechanism and fail-closed implementation are defective.
Multiple-key rescue is described but not implemented; canonical surname heuristic is knowingly broken.
Formulas are correct; malformed inputs, zero-denominator state and recall/clerical-queue relationship are not safe.
Human review boundary is clear but threshold policy drifts and queue is overstated as compensation for recall loss.
Separation from ER is clear but surname feature, missing signals and pair-distance domain model are wrong.
Prose is directional; code silently makes the graph undirected.
Queue-priority scope is stated, but uncertainty incorrectly derives from ER-vs-REL disagreement and explanation is insufficient to reconstruct inputs.
Canonical boundary code is correct, but handoff uses generic score and prior review-band text conflicts.
Theory prints dictionaries; learner-visible dashboard/map construction is external and unbridged.
Lesson's local definition omits material roadmap-required checkpoint fields/evidence.
Reduced to checklist/self-attestation instead of executable roadmap-required regression evidence.
Command is printed but target module was not found/taught in inspected main source.

When S14 introduces ndarray versus Python list, explicitly bridge from the usable collection model rather than assuming shape/dtype/vectorization knowledge.
Audit first exposure to dtype, shape, axis, masks, ufunc/reduction and broadcasting for widow terms and causal examples.
Check views/copies and mutation carefully because earlier aliasing/copy concepts had historical misconceptions.
Validate numeric precision/NaN behavior and do not import S02 float/Decimal misconceptions into NumPy explanations.
Keep S14 scope on NumPy; do not use the S13 capstone closure narrative as a substitute for a clean Level-1-to-Level-2 prerequisite bridge.
